# Anmol Chemicals

> Anmol Chemicals is a Mumbai-based pharmaceutical excipient manufacturer delivering excellence in chemical solutions for the pharma industry.

Anmol Chemicals specializes in manufacturing high-quality pharmaceutical excipients and specialty chemicals that meet international standards (USP, BP, IP, FCC). The company is headquartered in Mumbai, India and maintains rigorous quality assurance and R&D capabilities to serve the global pharmaceutical market.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Excipients
- Specialty Chemicals
- USP/BP/IP/FCC Standards
- Quality Assurance (QA)
- Quality Control (QC)
- Research & Development (R&D)
- API Manufacturing
- Pharma Industry
- Mumbai, India
- Calcium Acetate
- Food Grade Chemicals
- Company Values
- Innovation
- Customer Focus
- Regulatory Compliance
